isolated_actual_function_probe.method: Copied exact pinned crates/asr/src/hotwords.rs into an independent Rust wrapper. Fictional primary/shared/audio directories contain minimal fictional BPE models and equal synthetic inventories. Held primary directory open with FILE_SHARE_READ and the production open flags, then created a new primary BPE.

actual_asr_crate_tests.target: independent local Cargo target, existing Sherpa SDK, static CRT

limits: The wrapper tests the pinned vocabulary function with equivalent directory open flags; it is not a product receipt or live worker process race test.
The crate tests are deterministic fictional input tests, not neural inference, real ASR quality, model admission, GPU or release acceptance.
No user model, microphone, recording, network download or GPU was used.
